responsibility: Implements 32-bit x86 ABI lowering for multiple calling-convention flavors by classifying aggregate returns, byval stack-passed aggregates, MSVC overalignment rules, integer extension, optional inreg register assignment for fastcall/vectorcall/regparm, and Rust-ABI return adjustments that avoid x87/SSE float register conventions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/x86.rs`, this file classifies 32-bit x86 call arguments and returns across calling-convention flavors, including struct-return rules, byval stack layout, MSVC overalignment, and `inreg` assignment, not inline-assembly register syntax.
